overview: A former resistance fighter seeking a new beginning in Tamil Nadu unknowingly becomes entangled in a deadly game orchestrated by a group of powerful rich men driven by greed and control. A thrilling battle of intelligence, courage and survival unfolds, leaving everyone wondering as the hunt intensifies, his mysterious past and unbreakable spirit turn a ruthless game of survival into an unpredictable battle. They chose their prey but they never expected a predator.
title: BLACK TIGER
